title: Unit 5: Wonders of Viet Nam & Natural Beauty

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Natural & Man-made Wonders
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Natural & Man-made Wonders.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Used with reporting verbs (say, believe, think, report, claim): It is + past participle + that + clause.
concepts.example: It is believed that Ha Long Bay was formed over millions of years by geological movements.
concepts.essence: Expresses general public opinions without specifying who holds the belief.

concepts.definition: Suggest + V-ing OR Suggest that + Subject + (should) + bare infinitive.
concepts.example: The tour guide suggested that we visit Trang An eco-tourism complex early in the morning.
concepts.essence: The subjunctive bare infinitive is used regardless of the subject (he, she, they).

rules.statement: Two forms of Impersonal Passive transformation
rules.meaning: People say that S + V -> 1) It is said that S + V. 2) S + is/are said + to-V (hoặc to have P2 nếu xảy ra trước).
rules.example: People believe that Son Doong Cave is the largest cave in the world -> Son Doong Cave is believed to be the largest cave in the world.
rules.essence: Frequently tested transformation pattern in Grade 10 English exams.

workedExamples.prompt: Rewrite using impersonal passive: 'People report that thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.'
steps: Bước 1: Sử dụng cấu trúc: It is reported that...
Bước 2: Giữ nguyên mệnh đề sau that: 'thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.'
Bước 3: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh: 'It is reported that thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.'
workedExamples.answer: It is reported that thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.

commonMistakes.mistake: Writing 'suggest someone to do something': 'She suggested me to go there.'
commonMistakes.why: 'Suggest' never takes an object + to-infinitive. Correct: 'She suggested that I should go there' or 'She suggested going there.'
